listings.listing_title: Handcrafted Terracotta Diya Set — Made in Rampur
listings.description_en: A set of hand-shaped terracotta diyas made by artisan Meera Devi in Rampur, Rajasthan. Each diya is sun-dried and hand-painted with traditional motifs.
listings.description_local: Rampur, Rajasthan ki karigar Meera Devi dwara haath se banayi gayi mitti ki diya. Dhoop mein sukhayi gayi, paramparik design ke saath.
photo_guidance: show size next to a coin
one close-up of the painted motif
listings.story: Every purchase supports a rural artisan family in Rampur and contributes to the local school's development fund.

listings.listing_title: Homemade Mango Pickle — Sun-Dried, No Preservatives
listings.description_en: Traditional homemade mango pickle from Devgaon, Madhya Pradesh. Sun-dried, no preservatives, made in small batches by Ramesh Kumar.
listings.description_local: Devgaon, Madhya Pradesh ka ghar ka bana hua aam ka achaar. Dhoop mein sukhaya hua, bina preservative, Ramesh Kumar dwara chhote batch mein banaya gaya.
photo_guidance: show the label with the ingredients
listings.story: Each jar supports a rural food producer family in Devgaon and helps fund the local CSC center.
